configuration.amendment: Amended before any candidate was scored and before any ensemble was built (the seven original learner chains were already running on arcw1/arcw2/arcw4 with the runner at the hash recorded under parents.learner_code_run_adsb_learner): two learner variants with the ADS-B-residual target were added (target = label minus the observed ADS-B taxi, takeoff minus motion start, on matched rows; the plain label elsewhere; the offset is added back), fitted on arcw3 with the runner at the hash recorded under parents.learner_code_run_adsb_learner_amended; ensembles ens_v15_res and ens_v15_mix and their six blend candidates were added; nothing else changed. Rationale: a tree ensemble reproduces the near-identity relation between the label and the observed taxi only piecewise; fitting the gap removes that burden (the same device as the v12 residual on v9 and the NM-residual learner). Bookkeeping (02:05 UTC): the declared runner is snapshotted at docs/adsb_v15/run_adsb_learner_declared.py so that both hashes stay checkable; the nested ensembles are built with the unchanged tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py by listing members with multiplicities that reproduce the two-level mean exactly (every label-target learner predicts every row, so the flat mean over the multiset equals the mean of group means).

development_baseline.name: v14 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then (1 - 0.6) * that + 0.6 * adsb_full_v14 (runs/adsb_full_ens, the v14 learner mean, out-of-sample per fold) on every row outside LIRF, floored; reproduces 331.31 / 273.17 / 194.21 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025 (docs/adsb_v12_v5/development_results.json, ens_all_60)

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

ens_v15_bag.rule: mean of finite predictions of the two kind-level means

ens_v15_mix.rule: mean of finite predictions of the two group means

ens_v15_seeds.rule: mean of finite predictions of the two kind-level seed means

ensembles.missing_members: if a learner variant fails to complete on all three folds it is dropped from every ensemble that lists it and the drop is recorded in the selection; no other change
ensembles.tool: tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py (per-row mean of finite member predictions, fold by fold; run after the learner fits; member hashes recorded in each ensemble's run.json)

execution.learner_fits_on_workers: tools/launch_adsb_learners.py (16 threads per fit, one variant chain per worker)

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

adsb_full_v14.description: the v14 learner mean (LightGBM + CatBoost, no LIRF), used only to reproduce the v14 development baseline

ens_v15_mix.description: ensemble ens_v15_mix as declared in the amendment

ens_v15_res.description: ensemble ens_v15_res as declared in the amendment

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.recipe: v14 = (1 - 0.6) * (v9 + 1.0 * v12 ADS-B residual on matched rows outside LIRF) + 0.6 * mean(LightGBM, CatBoost full-data learners without LIRF) on every row outside LIRF, floored (configs/adsb_v12_v5.json, ens_all_60)

learner_common.features: timeline bundle CORE + FLOWN + SURFACE (276) + 27 ADS-B features from data/external/adsblol/matches (matches2_*, stands.parquet: exactly the tables the v14 learners used; hashes recorded in every run record)
learner_common.folds: seasonal and forward (out-of-sample fold predictions), refit on the eleven 2025 months at the median best iteration
learner_common.settings: configs/timeline_v1.json (lightgbm / catboost blocks; parameter overrides above)

cat_long.note: the v14 CatBoost hit its 6,000-round cap on both folds while still improving; same parameters with a 20,000-round cap

lgb_adsbres.note: timeline_v1 parameters; target = label - adsb_motion_s on matched rows, label elsewhere

lgb_clean.note: timeline_v1 parameters; fitting and early-stopping rows with labels above 43,200 s (one-day rows) are left out; every row is still predicted

lgb_deep.note: slower, deeper, more column-subsampled LightGBM for diversity

lgb_s16.note: timeline_v1 LightGBM parameters, new seed (seed bagging with runs/adsb_full_nolirf, seed 20260915)

learner_code_run_adsb_learner.note: snapshot of tools/run_adsb_learner.py as declared (the file on disk is the amended runner, parents.learner_code_run_adsb_learner_amended); the arcw1/arcw2/arcw4 chains run this declared version

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v14 (official 243.5805, 1st of 148 at 00:51 UTC 16 September). Diagnostics run before this declaration on the recorded v14 development predictions: (1) LIRF: even gate-covered LIRF segments show the airport block time a median 373-495 s before the ADS-B motion start with an interquartile spread of about 400 s (EDDF gate rows: within 60 s), so the LIRF label is not the observable pushback; a LIRF-only residual (matched non-population rows, v12 features, leave-one-month-out Jul<->Nov, Jan has no LIRF coverage) was WORSE than v14 on both months (+0.17% / +2.01% at weight 1.0; +0.04% / +0.47% at 0.5); LIRF stays excluded from every candidate, as in v11-v14. (2) First-point geometry features (first-point and stand latitude/longitude, bearing, 250 m grid cell) added to the v12 residual: null (+0.05% / -0.04% / -0.14% on Jan / Jul / Nov versus v12); not declared. (3) Blend structure on the recorded predictions: per-airport or per-match-status weights and a three-way least-squares stack (v12, LightGBM, CatBoost) fitted leave-one-month-out are null or worse than the fixed w = 0.6 mean (best mean +0.02%); not declared. (4) The remaining non-LIRF error is spread over ordinary matched and unmatched rows (Nov 2025: matched 27.5% of SSE, unmatched 34.8%, LIRF 37.7%); the lever declared here is learner strength and diversity: seed bagging, a longer CatBoost (its 6,000-round cap bound on both v14 folds), a deeper column-subsampled LightGBM and a one-day-label-cleaned LightGBM. No learner variant listed here had been fitted before this declaration.

residual_model.applies_to: the residual model is exactly v12's (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0; it reproduces the v12 development residuals); each candidate then blends the result with a declared v15 learner ensemble, value = (1 - w) * (v9 + residual) + w * ensemble, on every row outside LIRF; rows outside both scopes keep v9 exactly. The learner prediction is never a residual feature.
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

configuration.selection: For each candidate (ensemble, blend weight w), RMSE of the blended prediction on each held-out month versus the v14 development prediction on the same rows (all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v14 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0) and its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.997. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v14; otherwise select nothing. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v14 are descriptive only.
